instruction: Review the existing calculator.py implementation and memory.json to understand the current calculator behavior, available structure, and whether the UI should extend or replace the existing code.

decision: Reviewed calculator.py and memory.json; retain and extend the existing Tkinter calculator rather than replacing it.
findings: calculator.py contains a safe AST evaluator, formatting helpers, a Tkinter CalculatorApp UI, keyboard input, arithmetic buttons, error handling, and inline assertions. memory.json contains only the prior review record and no additional UI decisions.
